scope: Optimized arm64 macOS, real GRDB mailbox index and blob database. One unchanged seed written by the baseline. Each workload/variant starts twice in a fresh process and issues seven new-reader opens per process. First process-open, repeated prepared disk lookup and in-reader header refresh are distinct; OS file caches are uncontrolled. Eviction deletes a single prepared copy, checks the miss, reparses original MIME, saves and opens through the ordinary path. Synthetic HTML pictures use in-message cid references without network access. The production disk preparer emits native text (including picture blocks); no case claims a designed web view was opened. Resident footprint includes the whole host and no on-screen reader.
